metadata.description: Repository-hosted marketplace for the BrotherME plugin. Add it with claude plugin marketplace add khalilmaaouni/BrotherModeUp@<released-tag> to pin the marketplace add to that tag instead of the repository's moving default branch (docs/RELEASE.md names the re-pin step at every release); the git-clone install described in the repository README remains the most-proven path.
